text:
Maria (Finance): Received invoice 2023-089 from NovaCloud Ltd (CY). They deducted 15% withholding and didn’t attach a W-8BEN-E. Can tax advise?
Sam (Sales): They billed via Cyprus entity to simplify EU VAT. Sales didn’t expect US WHT. SOW #77 shows net payment language.
Liam (Legal): @Maria can you upload the invoice PDF and confirm where the work was performed?
Invoice Bot: invoice_2023-089.pdf uploaded — Vendor: NovaCloud Ltd (CY); Gross e24,000; VAT 0%; Withholding 15% (e3,600); Net e20,400.
Igor (Tax): If services are US-sourced, we may need to withhold unless we have a W-8BEN-E or treaty proof. If services performed outside US, likely foreign-source and no US WHT.
Sophie (APAC): Onboarding calls and delivery were run from EU/APAC only; no US personnel onsite.
Liam (Legal): Oral statements don’t substitute for docs — ask for W-8BEN-E and Cyprus tax citation if they assert mandatory withholding.
Maria (Finance): Draft vendor message: "Please provide completed W-8BEN-E, Cyprus TIN, and clarification on service location; if you assert Cyprus withholding, please cite statutory basis." Good?
Igor (Tax): Also ask for an invoice reissue showing gross amount and whether they expect us to gross-up. If no W-8, prepare to withhold and notify compliance. If they provide W-8 showing foreign status, pay gross.
Sam (Sales): Note from vendor: "we always withhold 15% for cross-border clients" — salesperson thinks this is a mistaken blanket policy.
Maria (Finance): Marked invoice on hold in AP portal. Sent vendor request, requested response within 5 business days. If no docs, finance to proceed per IRS rules and withhold.
Liam (Legal): I’ll draft simple gross-up addendum template in case we agree to reimburse withheld amounts, and flag SOW wording for future contracts.
Sophie (APAC): Looping their AM now to expedite docs. :pray:
Maria (Finance): Will follow up next Tue if no reply. Closing thread for now. :thumbsup:
